title: A 1.4GHz 20.5Gbps GZIP decompression accelerator in 14nm CMOS featuring dual-path out-of-order speculative Huffman decoder and multi-write enabled register file array
relevance: State-of-the-art ASIC GZIP decompressor achieving 20.5 Gbps with dual speculative paths. The hardware benchmark for DEFLATE decompression.

title: A 43.3 bit/cycle Inflate Accelerator Featuring Static-Dynamic Huffman Decoder with Multiple Checkpoints and Optimized End-Of-Block Control for Hyperscale data
relevance: Latest hardware inflate accelerator achieving 43.3 bits/cycle with multiple checkpoints for improved speculation success rate.

title: FPGA implementation of high throughput encoder and decoder design of lossless canonical Huffman machine
relevance: FPGA-based canonical Huffman codec achieving 144-991 GB/s throughput with 3.30 mW leakage power.

title: HT-Deflate-FPGA
relevance: Open-source high-throughput DEFLATE FPGA implementation from UCLA's VAST lab.
